Chat request that includes a developer role message alongside user messages

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"You are a coding assistant. Always respond with concise code examples.\",\"role\":\"developer\"},{\"content\":\"How do I reverse a string in Python?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
let result = try await LiterLlm.chat(req: _req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
```
